title: zia_url_categories: REMOVE_FROM_LIST update fails with 400 "Request body is invalid"

blocks.heading: zia_url_categories: REMOVE_FROM_LIST update fails with 400 "Request body is invalid"

blocks.text: Updating an existing ZIA custom URL category with `zscaler.ziacloud.zia_url_categories` (`state: present`) fails when the module needs to remove URLs. Starting in collection **2.1.0** (PR [#108](https://github.com/zscaler/ziacloud-ansible/pull/108)), updates use incremental `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` / `ADD_TO_LIST` instead of a full category replace. The `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` call returns HTTP 400 (`Request body is invalid.`), so URLs are not removed from Zscaler and the Ansible task fails.

This blocks automation that syncs a blacklist (or similar) custom URL category from a desired list into ZIA when the category already contains URLs that must be deleted. The same playbook pattern worked before the incremental-update change (reported working ~3 months ago; fails repeatedly in prod and pre-prod).

With `state: present` and a desired `urls` list, the ZIA category should match that list: URLs not in the desired set should be removed, and the task should complete with `changed: true` without API 400 errors. Behavior should match pre-2.1.0 full-update semantics, or `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` should send a request body the ZIA API accepts.
The module diffs current vs desired URLs and calls `update_url_category(..., action="REMOVE_FROM_LIST", **remove_payload)`. ZIA returns 400. Representative task result:

blocks.code:
{
  "ansible_job_id": "j895969414117.163",
  "changed": false,
  "finished": 1,
  "msg": "Failed to remove URLs from category: {\n  \"status\": 400,\n  \"code\": null,\n  \"message\": \"Request body is invalid.\",\n  \"url\": \"https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/urlCategories/CUSTOM_XX\"\n}",
  "results_file": "/root/.ansible_async/j895969414117.163",
  "started": 1,
  "stderr": "",
  "stderr_lines": [],
  "stdout": "",
  "stdout_lines": []
}

blocks.text: With `ignore_errors: yes`, the failure is ignored and stale URLs remain on the category. At higher verbosity, the module emits a warning like `Payload for SDK (REMOVE_FROM_LIST): {...}` before the error.

Relevant code path in `plugins/modules/zia_url_categories.py` (approx. lines 396–427 on 2.2.4): build `urls_to_remove` / `db_to_remove`, copy full `updated_data` into `remove_payload`, then call `REMOVE_FROM_LIST`.
Suspected contributing factors in the current remove path:

blocks.item: **`remove_payload` includes non-URL category fields and module defaults** (`custom_category: true`, `type: URL_CATEGORY`, `configured_name`, etc.) on a `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` action. ZIA may reject that body; a minimal payload with only `urls` / `db_categorized_urls` to remove may be required.

**Omitted list parameters are treated as empty desired lists** during diff. If the playbook only sets `configured_name` and `urls`, existing `db_categorized_urls` can be queued for removal unintentionally.
**Large remove batches** (hundreds/thousands of URLs in one `REMOVE_FROM_LIST`) may exceed what the API accepts; chunking removes or falling back to a full replace for large diffs could help.

blocks.text: Possible fixes: send a minimal body for `REMOVE_FROM_LIST`/`ADD_TO_LIST`; treat unspecified list fields as “leave unchanged” rather than `[]`; chunk large removals; or fall back to the pre-2.1.0 full `update_url_category` when the remove set is large / when the incremental call fails.
Workarounds today: pin `zscaler.ziacloud` to **< 2.1.0**; pass complete desired state for all list fields the module diffs; batch removals in the playbook.

blocks.item: Install `zscaler.ziacloud` **2.1.0 or later** (`ansible-galaxy collection list zscaler.ziacloud`).
Use or create a custom URL category that already contains multiple URLs **not** in the desired list (use a large list to mirror production).

blocks.code:
- name: Update category with desired URLs
  zscaler.ziacloud.zia_url_categories:
    configured_name: "{{ blacklist_category_name }}"
    urls:
      - .subdomain.example.net
    state: present
  register: update_result

blocks.item: Observe task failure with `Failed to remove URLs from category` and HTTP 400 `Request body is invalid` against `/zia/api/v1/urlCategories/<CUSTOM_ID>`.

blocks.text: Optional production-like conditions: desired list much smaller than remote (e.g. slice of a normalized list), `async`/`poll`, `ignore_errors: yes`.
N/A — failure is API/Ansible task output (see Current behavior JSON). Capture the `Payload for SDK (REMOVE_FROM_LIST):` module warning from a verbose run if useful (redact URLs/category names).
This issue was reported via support case with Red Hat.

blocks.item: Collection: zscaler.ziacloud **2.1.0+** (reproduced analysis against **2.2.4**; regression introduced in **2.1.0** / PR #108)
Zscaler SDK Python Library & version (e.g. zscaler-sdk-python 0.1.1): collection requires `zscaler-sdk-python>=1.9.30`;
